chapter: British revival and the Crane River band
title: Hostile reception and the Bunk Johnson and Armstrong debate
summary: Early critics were hostile to the Bunk Johnson and George Lewis records; Colyer felt they were the authentic idiom and was never greatly impressed by Armstrong.
